subject: South Medford Stormwater Mitigation Support
overview: The council rescheduled several upcoming meetings and received updates on city-led climate initiatives including curbside composting and building code training. The body also heard a presentation on infrastructure improvements in South Medford and approved a letter of support for a Municipal Vulnerability Preparedness grant to fund drainage upgrades.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the February 26 meeting.

items.title: Meeting Rescheduling and Format
items.summary: Rescheduled the April meeting to the 29th and the June meeting to the 24th, with an agreement to meet in person at City Hall for the April session.

items.title: City Action Updates
items.summary: Reviewed progress on the website translation widget, the soft launch of the Electrify Medford program, and the recruitment of over 800 residents for the free curbside composting program.

items.title: Electricity Aggregation and Energy Code Updates
items.summary: Discussed bidding for the city's electricity supply contract to increase renewable content and provided an update on specialized energy code training for building inspectors.

items.title: Energy and Environment Committee Report
items.summary: Heard reports on three proposed tree ordinances regarding public and private property and received an update on climate-related bills pending in the state legislature.

items.title: Make Polluters Pay Legislative Discussion
items.summary: Discussed the carbon emissions fund legislation and a potential City Council resolution supporting the bill.

items.title: South Medford Stormwater Mitigation Support
items.summary: Approved a letter of support for a grant application to fund drainage upgrades on Bowen and Golden Avenues after a presentation by City Engineer Owen Wartella on localized flood mitigation.
